copy.curiosityHook: With their official backing severed, how do two sidelined agents expose a hidden faction before an extraterrestrial takeover becomes inevitable?
copy.description: After being pulled off the FBI's X Files unit, Mulder and Scully confront shadowy government forces while tracking a clandestine plot that points toward the alien colonization of Earth.
copy.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful sci-fi thriller driven by conspiratorial tension, rewarding engaged and solitary late-night viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Director Rob Bowman expands the investigation to a cinematic canvas, delivering a tense, plot-driven mystery where institutional secrecy clashes with existential discovery.

allowedMaterial: Mulder and Scully removed from X Files cases
Conspiracy involving potential alien colonization of Earth
Initial investigation setup and thriller atmosphere
excludedMaterial: Identity of conspirators or specific Syndicate figures
Specific plot twists regarding alien biology or virus details
Ultimate fate of the X Files division
